definitions.name: registerScriptRunTool
definitions.expression: function registerScriptRunTool(server){server.registerTool("browser.script.run",{description:"Run a browser automation script against the Matrix Browser runtime.",inputSchema:ScriptRunInput.shape,outputSchema:ScriptRunOutput.shape,_meta:{"neo/alwaysLoad":true,"neo/searchHint":"browser script run playwright webpage automation"}},async(args,extra)=>{try{const result=await runtime.run({departmentId:departmentId(extra),script:args.script,timeoutMs:normalizeOperationTimeoutMs(args.timeoutMs),signal:extra.signal});return scriptRunResult(result)}catch(error48){return toolErrorResult("browser.script.run",error48)}})}

definitions.name: registerTaskMessageTool
definitions.expression: function registerTaskMessageTool(server){server.registerTool("browser.task.message",{description:"Send a message to the browser agent. Use taskId null to start a task; provide a taskId string for a follow-up message.",inputSchema:TaskMessageInput.shape,outputSchema:TaskMessageOutput.shape,_meta:{"neo/alwaysLoad":true,"neo/searchHint":"browser task message visual webpage interaction automation"}},async(args,extra)=>{try{return taskMessageResult(await browserTaskManager.message({departmentId:departmentId2(extra),taskId:args.taskId,message:args.message,timeoutMs:args.timeoutMs,signal:extra.signal}))}catch(error51){return toolErrorResult("browser.task.message",error51)}})}
